## Summary

A brief description of the feature you are requesting.

## Motivation

Why is this feature needed? What problem does it solve?

## Proposed Solution

Describe how you envision this feature working.

## Example

Provide an example of how this feature would be used:

**Input:**
```json
{
  "example": "input"
}
```

**Expected Output:**
```
example: output
```

## Alternatives Considered

Have you considered any alternative solutions or workarounds?

## Impact

Which components would this affect?

- [ ] toon-core (Rust library)
- [ ] toon-cli (Command-line tool)
- [ ] toon-wasm (WebAssembly/npm package)
- [ ] toon-py (Python bindings)
- [ ] Specification
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional Context

Add any other context, references, or screenshots about the feature request here.

## JSON-LD Keyword Support

If this is a request for a new JSON-LD keyword, please specify:

- **Keyword**: [e.g., @nest]
- **JSON-LD Spec Reference**: [link to relevant section]
- **Use Case**: Brief description of when this keyword is used
